title: Chemistry most popular subject after English for 12th CBSE students

Notably, the disparity between chemistry and business studies has skyrocketed since 2019. title: 7th high court posting? Justice Rao may be Karnataka Chief Justice

This potential appointment would mark his seventh high court assignment since 2012 when he became a judge. He has previously served as Chief Justice in four high courts over a short period. Justice Rao has experienced multiple transfers throughout his judicial career due to various circumstances.

title: ‘Fighting against BJP or us?’ Congress slams Samajwadi Party over its list

title: Lamp not lit atop deepathoon, Supreme Court to hear contempt case

This non-compliance may trigger contempt proceedings against the Madurai Collector, despite his apology. Various political parties and the Madurai district administration oppose the lighting of the lamp atop the deepathoon. title: India tops in videos removed from YouTube
summary: YouTube took down approximately 34.4 lakh videos from India in the second quarter of 2026. This number represented a 28% increase from the previous quarter's removals. Globally, child safety issues were responsible for the majority of video removals. Additionally, Indian courts and government agencies sent numerous removal requests to Google. Police primarily initiated these requests, reflecting a growing trend in content regulation.

title: Trump slaps new tariffs on 14 nations; India faces additional 17%

title: ‘Our artists bringing new perspectives to art world’: PM Modi after Venice Biennale award

title: Exporters in better position but brace for uncertainty
